data.name: Jamilaah
data.gender_notes: Jamilaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jamilaah is derived from the Arabic root 'jamal' which means beauty, grace, and loveliness. In Islamic tradition, it is a name given to girls born with an inherent beauty, purity, and elegance. The name Jamilaah carries the meaning “Beautiful, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamilaah usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of divine beauty and perfection
data.etymology: Jamilaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamilaah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
